desc: Read N, K and array A; compute `MAXA = max(A)`.
Build `freq[0..MAXA]` array (list of int) from A.
Precompute SPF up to MAXA (linear sieve or simple O(n log log n)).
Compute `cnt[0..MAXA]` by iterating each value v with freq[v] > 0, generating divisors of v via SPF, and adding freq[v] to cnt[d] for each divisor d.
For each A_i: generate divisors of A_i using SPF; keep max d with `cnt[d] >= K`; store answer.
Core observation: answer_i = max{ d | d divides A_i and cnt[d] >= K }.
Use SPF to avoid storing all divisor lists and keep memory low.
